sources.title: Value Added Tax Act, Chapter 148 (consolidated as at 30 November 2019)
sources.coverage: standard VAT rate (Section 5(1)); zero-rating mechanism (Section 5(2)); zero-rated exports (Section 55)
sources.notes: Value Added Tax Act, 2014 (Act No. 5 of 2014), assented to 11 December 2014, commenced 1 July 2015, repealing the 1997 VAT Act (Cap 148, Act No. 24 of 1997). Consolidated text as at 30 November 2019 by TanzLII/Laws.Africa; there may be updates since this consolidation.

sources.title: The Excise (Management and Tariff) Act, Chapter 147 (R.E. 2019)
sources.institution: Wizara ya Fedha na Mipango (Ministry of Finance and Planning, Tanzania)
sources.coverage: excise duty imposition (Section 124); Fourth Schedule rates for a subset of excisable goods (fruit/vegetable juices, mineral/aerated waters)
sources.notes: Downloaded directly from the Ministry of Finance and Planning (primary government source, not a legislation aggregator). Revised Edition 2019; TanzLII notes outstanding amendments (Acts of 2020-2024) not yet applied to this consolidation. The Fourth Schedule covers dozens of HS headings; only a representative subset was transcribed into excise_measures.json this cycle.
